// diagnostic E2122

Jet.DottedPathPrefixUnresolved

`{path}` starts with {start}.

What

`{path}` starts with {start}.

Why

A dotted path splits at its longest prefix that names one module of the program, and the rest names a declaration in that module.

Fix

Start the path with the dotted name of exactly one module of the program: {modules}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.DottedPathPrefixUnresolved: Tests/UI/deep_checks_unknown_prefix.stderr.

Error: Jet.DottedPathPrefixUnresolved: `forest.run` starts with no module of this program.
 Why: A dotted path splits at its longest prefix that names one module of the program, and the rest names a declaration in that module.
 Fix: Start the path with the dotted name of exactly one module of the program: `tree`.
